subject: Acme SOC2 re-attestation: retention window change & seat increase
messages:
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — proposed evidence window change

Hi Vanessa,

We are coming up on our annual renewal and Acme's security/compliance team has asked for a couple of changes before we sign: mainly a longer log retention window for the attestation period (moving from 30 -> 90 days) and confirmation that Redwood can reissue the SOC 2 evidence package for our renewed term. We're also evaluating a modest seat/capacity bump to handle expected seasonal query volume for Q3.

Can you share your target timeline for the SOC2 re-attestation and a list of the evidence artifacts you'll provide (attestation PDF, audit logs, KMS/HSM attestation, retention policy statement)? Procurement is trying to align the PO timing with the attestation date. I attached our updated questionnaire with specific asks.

If it helps, we can do a short sync next week to run through the asks and confirm the scope.

Thanks,
Emily Ross
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme_questionnaire_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — proposed evidence window change

On Thu, May 2, 2028 at 09:12 Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmeanalytics.com> wrote:
> We are coming up on our annual renewal and Acme's security/compliance team has asked for a couple of changes before we sign...

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. We're able to support a 90-day log retention window for the attestation period; Marcus and I discussed the implementation impact and cost delta.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- Redwood provides a reissued SOC 2 attestation PDF scoped to the renewal term (deliverable by May 30 if we can reconcile a few outstanding items).
- Engineering will prepare a 90-day log export for the attestation window by May 14 (we'll provide sample files and a checksum).
- Sales/Finance to confirm PO timing; Marcus can share an updated pricing estimate for the seat/capacity bump.
- I will create a shared Drive folder and drop interim artifacts there. Link below.

Can you confirm whether Acme wants the term extended to 24 months as part of the renewal (we have a seat discount at annual commits)? That affects procurement timing.

I'll coordinate a short technical call next week with Marcus and Karthik to walk through the log export format and evidence packaging.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 May 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation — log retention & capacity notes

Vanessa / Karthik — a couple of technical notes we should bring to the call: 

- 90-day retention: We can produce a contiguous 90-day audit log export from our logging pipeline. Output will be gzipped JSONL with per-record timestamps and trace ids. Estimated export size for Acme's account ~120GB (we will provide a sample 48-hour slice for validation).
- Cost/ops: Keeping the 90d window for attestation increases short-term S3 storage and export costs; I ran a quick delta and it looks like ~$1.8k incremental for the export and staging period (we'll absorb small costs for evidence prep but pass through major storage).
- Capacity bump: For Q3 surge, recommend bumping Dedicated pool from 8 -> 12 GPUs for a two-month window; Marcus will create an uplift quote.

Attached is a short CSV with log window options and the rough cost delta.

–Marcus
Lead Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: log_window_options.csv (csv)

From: Tom Hsu <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: PO draft for renewal / seat increase

Vanessa,

Thanks for the timeline — attached is our draft PO for the renewal and the requested seat increase. We'd like to lock pricing and the 90-day retention commitment into the SOW addendum before routing to legal. Can you confirm the attestation delivery file name and the point of contact for signature?

We asked Acme legal to hold off until Redwood confirms the attestation PDF and the retention phrasing.

Best,
Tom Hsu
Procurement
Acme Analytics

Attachments: PO_draft_ACME.pdf (pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — confirmation and next steps

Tom / Emily — thanks. Confirming next steps and agreed items: 

1) Redwood will deliver the SOC2 attestation PDF named "SOC2-2027-Attestation.pdf" to the shared Drive folder by COB May 30. That document will be scoped to the renewed term and reference the 90-day log retention window for the attestation period.
2) Engineering will drop the 90-day log export sample in the Drive folder by May 14 (sample already uploaded; full export to follow if required by auditors).
3) We have a provisional uplift quote for Dedicated capacity (8 -> 12 GPUs) for a 2-month window; Marcus will send formal quote and cost lines to procurement.
4) Procurement: once you confirm the PO draft, we will provide the SOW addendum text for the retention clause and the DocuSign link.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Friday, May 31 at 10:00 PT to close open items (evidence checklist + SOW language). If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-2027-Attestation.pdf (pdf)
Related links: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC-ACME-2028, https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345
